1) we propose a novel method to train an annotator to predict labels for synthetic images generated by a GAN; 2) we formulate this annotator training as a learning-to-anotate problem and reduce it to a gradient matching problem; and 3) we demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on semi-supervised part-segmentation tasks.

(i) we formulate the learning to annotate problem as a nested loop optimization problem, (ii) reduce this problem to an efficient gradient matching problem, (iii) evaluate our approach in the context of part segmentation and show that it significantly outperforms existing semi-supervised approaches when the number of labelled examples is very limited.
